acoustic_rayleigh_tpu_95a.structural_purpose: High-velocity non-contact boundary extrusion of dense 95A TPU (Plate 1). Sliced at a fine 0.16mm layer height with wall loops bumped to 5 to guarantee flawless, smooth toolpath tracking around the curved human-cochlea parabolic acoustic mirrors. Maintains a steady 2.0 Bar continuous compressed-air purge through the internal scrubber jacket to shield the crystals from thermal depolarization.

acoustic_rayleigh_food_safe_pp.structural_purpose: High-velocity boundary extrusion of semi-crystalline Polypropylene (Plate 2). Optimized with a fine layer step-down to capture the smooth, expanding geometric contours of the internal chambered-nautilus logarithmic entry throat, completely wiping out entry fluid drag while running the 120 Hz torsional bed sweep to skip brittle crystallization rows across living hinges.
